field_conditions: Home laundering in hard water (about 250 ppm CaCO3) with detergent residue, tumble-drying at 60C, abrasion at elbows, shoulders and pack straps, and sweat and body-oil contamination.
protocol_changes: Wash in hard water with detergent residue and tumble-dry between spray-rating checks; add abrasion pre-conditioning (Martindale 5000 cycles) before the spray test; use actual fabric weight and a full agitation cycle; pass/fail on spray rating after 5 and 10 washes.
